summary: PORTUPDT is a batch program that applies field-level updates to portfolio records from a sequential update file. For each update record it reads the matching portfolio record (by key) and, based on the update action code, changes exactly one field: status ('S'), client name ('N'), or total value ('V', converted to numeric). It then REWRITEs the record, counting successes and errors. Records that can't be found or rewritten are reported. At the end it closes both files, prints update/error totals, and sets the job return code. Error conditions handled: file-open failure, record-not-found, and rewrite failure.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CALL 1000-INITIALIZE
WHILE NOT end of file DO
  CALL 2000-PROCESS
END WHILE
CALL 3000-TERMINATE
RETURN to caller (GOBACK)

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLEAR WS-WORK-AREAS
OPEN PORTFOLIO-FILE for READ-WRITE (I-O)
OPEN UPDATE-FILE for READ-ONLY
IF portfolio open NOT success OR update open NOT success THEN
  DISPLAY 'Error opening files' + statuses
  SET WS-RETURN-CODE = error (8)
  CALL 3000-TERMINATE
END IF

annotations.note: SME REVIEW: same non-stopping open-error pattern as PORTADD/PORTREAD — terminates (closes files) but control returns and the mainline then reads closed files.

paragraphs.name: 2000-PROCESS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
READ next record from UPDATE-FILE
IF end of file THEN SET END-OF-FILE = true
ELSE CALL 2100-PROCESS-UPDATE
END IF
branches: READ ... AT END / NOT AT END

paragraphs.name: 2100-PROCESS-UPDATE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET PORT-KEY = UPDT-KEY          -- the record to update
READ PORTFOLIO-FILE (by key)
IF read success THEN
  CALL 2200-APPLY-UPDATE
ELSE
  INCREMENT WS-ERROR-COUNT
  DISPLAY 'Record not found: ' + PORT-KEY
END IF
branches: IF portfolio read success -> apply update else count not-found

paragraphs.name: 2200-APPLY-UPDATE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SELECT CASE update action (UPDT-ACTION)
  WHEN 'S' (status): SET PORT-STATUS = UPDT-NEW-VALUE
  WHEN 'N' (name):   SET PORT-CLIENT-NAME = UPDT-NEW-VALUE
  WHEN 'V' (value):  SET WS-NUMERIC-WORK = UPDT-NEW-VALUE; SET PORT-TOTAL-VALUE = WS-NUMERIC-WORK
END SELECT
REWRITE PORT-RECORD
IF rewrite success THEN INCREMENT WS-UPDATE-COUNT
ELSE INCREMENT WS-ERROR-COUNT; DISPLAY 'Update failed for: ' + PORT-KEY
END IF
branches: IF rewrite success -> count update else count error

annotations.note: The 'V' branch moves a text field into a numeric work field then into the packed COMP-3 total-value — an implicit alphanumeric-to-numeric conversion; malformed input could corrupt the value with no explicit validation.
EVALUATE has no WHEN OTHER — an unrecognised action code silently updates nothing but still REWRITEs the (unchanged) record and counts it as a success.

paragraphs.name: 3000-TERMINATE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLOSE PORTFOLIO-FILE and UPDATE-FILE
DISPLAY 'Updates processed' and 'Errors occurred' with counts
SET job RETURN-CODE = WS-RETURN-CODE

usage.note: Produced by Claude Code in-session; no API call, no key, no token cost.
